S1.F1.source_file: Advancing speech summarization in Multi-modal LLMs with Reinforcement Learning
S1.F1.caption: Fig. 1: The overview of three-stage training process.
citing_paragraphs: We propose a three-stage training framework designed to enhance the speech summarization capabilities of multi-modal large language models (MLLMs). As illustrated in Figure 1 , the framework consists of: (1) Supervised finetuning (SFT) on synthetic data. (2) On-policy knowledge distillation (KD) to transfer summarization ability from strong text-based LLMs. (3) Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) to mitigate hallucinations.

contextual_paragraphs.html: For the knowledge distillation and DPO stages, we construct data using the same process but omit the summary generation step. We sample 35k high-quality audios with query for training. All of the above data are in English only.
